name: Crater rim arc piece
brief: MK-096 Crater rim arc piece: a quarter arc of a 9 m crater's raised lip, built as a faceted height field (inner wall falls away steeply, outer flank slopes gently) with ejecta boulders on the outside. Four of these close a crater; they also make low-g FPS cover. Colours follow the regolith grammar (simulations/moon/moon-regolith.mjs).

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
